problem:
The following equation is true for all values of $x.$

$$
{x}^{2}+2x+c={x}^{2}+2x+5
$$

What is the value of the constant $c?$

feedback.problem:
The following equation is true for all values of $x.$

$$
4{x}^{2}-7x+n=4{x}^{2}-7x+2
$$

What is the value of the constant $n?$
feedback.worked_solution:
Since the equation is true for all values of $x,$ the expressions on both sides must be exactly the same. That means the coefficients of the matching powers of $x$ must be equal.

We compare the constant terms on both sides. On the left-hand side, the constant is $n.$ On the right-hand side, the constant is $2.$

So, we have

$$
n=2.
$$
